name: ui-ownership-and-default-roles
changes: Kept UI and app modules on one active surface slot so activating one replaces the previous UI/app module.
Changed UI contribution validation to enforce schema 1.1 runtimeRequirements.ui declared IDs during activation.
Validated toolbar item IDs, toolbar overlay route IDs, view injection view IDs and slot IDs, overlay route IDs, navigation pointer IDs, and module overlay view IDs against manifest declarations.
Replaced unconditional themeMask stripping with validation that requires ui_theme_mask capability and declared theme IDs.
Removed the obsolete UIThemeMask compatibility warning when policy allows the capability.
Updated framework and implementation policy text to describe declared, policy-approved theme mask handling.
testsAdded: Schema 1.1 UI activation rejects undeclared toolbar item IDs.
Schema 1.1 declared theme masks are preserved in UISurfaceManager.
Compatibility checker allows UIThemeMask when policy allows it.

validation.command: python3 JSON parse over repository JSON files
rg stale themeMask stripping and UIThemeMask reserved text

knownLimitations: Native compile and test execution still require Windows/MSVC, CMake, CTest, vcpkg, and PowerShell.
